## Humana - Senior Software Engineer – Appian Platform

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer developing Appian workflow and case-management solutions for Humana's HIPAA-regulated healthcare operations. Building integrations, administering the platform, and supporting reliable software delivery.
Senior Software Engineer building Appian healthcare workflow solutions for Humana
- Salary: $106,900 - $147,000 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, Java, Kafka, Postgres, Python, SQL
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Design, code, and maintain software applications meeting business and platform requirements
- Deliver technical solutions and hands-on development expertise within a team environment
- Contribute to Appian platform administration
- Apply strong technical knowledge within the Appian domain
- Develop code that accelerates impactful initiatives in a HIPAA-regulated environment
- Design and develop software solutions using Appian process models, SAIL interfaces, record types, expression rules, AI enablement, and reusable components
- Configure and optimize the Appian platform and address technical issues
- Develop and maintain integrations between Appian and other systems using RESTful services, APIs, and enterprise data sources
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
- 4+ years of substantial, hands-on experience developing with Appian
- 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and testing software applications and/or infrastructure
- Experience building workflow-driven and case-based applications in medium-to-large-scale environments
- Good understanding of platform security, integrations, and data access patterns
- Exposure to regulated environments, including security, compliance, auditability, and reliability
- Hands-on experience with Web API development, messaging queues such as Kafka, and other Appian integration capabilities
- Familiarity with Appian SAIL, Records, Data Fabric, and platform deployment processes

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer developing Appian workflow and case-management solutions for Humana's HIPAA-regulated healthcare operations. Building integrations, administering the platform, and supporting reliable software delivery.
Senior Software Engineer building Appian healthcare workflow solutions for Humana
Role description:
• Design, code, and maintain software applications meeting business and platform requirements
• Deliver technical solutions and hands-on development expertise within a team environment
• Contribute to Appian platform administration
• Apply strong technical knowledge within the Appian domain
• Develop code that accelerates impactful initiatives in a HIPAA-regulated environment
• Design and develop software solutions using Appian process models, SAIL interfaces, record types, expression rules, AI enablement, and reusable components
• Configure and optimize the Appian platform and address technical issues
• Develop and maintain integrations between Appian and other systems using RESTful services, APIs, and enterprise data sources
• Support workflow and case management solutions based on Appian
• Evaluate and implement Appian platform features and upgrades
• Promote Appian best practices and alignment with engineering standards
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
• 4+ years of substantial, hands-on experience developing with Appian
• 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and testing software applications and/or infrastructure
• Experience building workflow-driven and case-based applications in medium-to-large-scale environments
• Good understanding of platform security, integrations, and data access patterns
• Exposure to regulated environments, including security, compliance, auditability, and reliability
• Hands-on experience with Web API development, messaging queues such as Kafka, and other Appian integration capabilities
• Familiarity with Appian SAIL, Records, Data Fabric, and platform deployment processes
• Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred
• Appian Certified Developer or equivalent Appian platform certification preferred
• Experience with Appian AI capabilities, including AI modeling and automation features preferred
• Experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, C#, or Python preferred
• Development or administration experience with SQL, relational databases, cloud databases, and data platforms preferred
• Databricks, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL preferred
• Object-oriented design and development techniques preferred
• Kafka or other enterprise messaging/event-streaming platforms preferred
• Minimum home internet speed of 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload for Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees
• Dedicated workspace without ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI/HIPAA information
Benefits:
• Bonus incentive plan based upon company and/or individual performance
• Medical, dental and vision benefits
• 401(k) retirement savings plan
• Paid time off
• Company and personal holidays
• Paid parental and caregiver leave
• Short-term and long-term disability
• Life insurance
• Personal wellness and smart healthcare decision support
• Remote work arrangement
• Occasional travel to Humana offices for training or meetings
• Dedicated workspace and internet service requirements for home/hybrid employees
Tech stack:
Cloud, Java, Kafka, Postgres, Python, SQL
